scope: Read-only time-boxed screen; none of these possibilities is admitted as a commercially loss-making cohort or a demonstrated enabling gap.

candidates.beneficiary: US small water systems and households served by service lines of unknown material
candidates.outcome: Produce trustworthy inventory classifications and direct physical confirmation/replacement resources without falsely declaring unsafe lines non-lead.
candidates.cohort_and_horizon: Would require a frozen utility inventory containing system/customer-side records, physical verification observations and a registered operational horizon; none acquired in this screen.
candidates.strong_complete_route: Records review plus existing statistical prioritization, random field validation, excavation/material inspection, public inventory maintenance and replacement/referral obligations.

primary_evidence.summary: EPA documents inventory elements, both ownership sides and material classes including unknown; it supplies guidance and a template.

Philadelphia describes a 2026 operational program that digs at selected properties to verify model/record information; investigation usually takes about two hours. Participation requires property authorization.

candidates.residual_constraint: A software model cannot establish an individual buried pipe's physical material from incomplete records. Full delivery needs observations and permissions absent here.
candidates.proposed_construction: A measurement/inspection selection instrument could combine records provenance and physical inspection design, rather than repeat prediction.
candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Check whether an existing compliant inspection/validation design already meets the same obligations on an accessible utility dataset; an in-silico prediction improvement does not suffice.
candidates.paying_party_and_capture: Water utility or its engineering contractor; demand for inventory work is documented, but no price, procurement award, purchase or AGI ALPHA participation is established.
candidates.second_use: Provenance-directed inspection of other hidden infrastructure assets
candidates.decision: DO_NOT_ADMIT: physical observations/access missing; also avoid predictor repetition

candidates.beneficiary: Public document owners and readers using assistive technology
candidates.outcome: Deliver semantically correct PDF content with logical reading/tab order, navigable links/forms and retained meaning.
candidates.cohort_and_horizon: Would require frozen complex public PDFs and an acceptance protocol including semantic order and assistive technology checks; no evaluated cohort admitted.
candidates.strong_complete_route: Repair original authoring structure and export tagged PDF; inspect and repair tags/order with established accessibility tools; test the delivered document.

primary_evidence.summary: W3C explains why complex layouts may export with incorrect reading order and describes authoring/repair routes and verification tests.
Canada's accessibility toolkit checklist includes reading order, keyboard navigation, language and form controls.

candidates.residual_constraint: Structural validators alone do not prove semantic reading order. Existing repair workflows are competent, and a complete human/assistive-technology acceptance route is not available in this runtime.
candidates.proposed_construction: A dual representation repair checker might bind semantic source blocks to tag-tree output and expose unresolved ordering ambiguity.
candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Run ordinary original-source export plus established repair/validation on the same documents before inventing; any complete successful incumbent route removes the claimed gap.
candidates.paying_party_and_capture: Document owner could buy remediation, but this screen establishes no observed purchase or supported price and cannot infer willingness to pay from accessibility need alone.
candidates.second_use: Accessible interactive forms or scientific reports
candidates.available_tools: pypdf, PyMuPDF, pdftotext installed; no qpdf or mutool; no complete assistive-technology user acceptance measured
candidates.decision: DO_NOT_ADMIT: complete acceptance and incumbent comparator not qualified

candidates.beneficiary: Maintainers/operators of security-exposed applications where safe dependency upgrades break compatibility
candidates.outcome: Remove specified vulnerable dependency versions while retaining installation, build and all baseline passing behavior.
candidates.cohort_and_horizon: A frozen set of pinned real vulnerable repositories/upgrades with clean baseline test identities and source-bound advisories; no admitted economic cohort.
candidates.strong_complete_route: Package-manager resolution and version upgrade, vulnerability rescan, ordinary codemod/manual or agent migration, fresh install/build/tests; competent AI-native controls include current specialized remediation agents.

primary_evidence.summary: pip-audit supports audit and automatic known-vulnerability fixing using package advisory data.

Current benchmark supplies 307 upgrades across 43 repositories and fresh verifier gates for resolve, rescan, build and tests. It reports 90.2% pass for Evo and 77.5% for Claude plus scan. Major migrations remain difficult. Runtime tasks require Snyk CLI/token and evaluated agent controls use paid model calls.
NIST explains SBOM procurement and sustaining vulnerability detection/remediation practices. This is demand context, not a purchase or AGI ALPHA revenue.

candidates.residual_constraint: Real major-version migrations remain incompletely automated, but the strongest observed current route is unavailable to execute under no-paid-call/no-token-grant authority.
candidates.proposed_construction: If a reproducible residual case is accessible, construct a bounded deterministic migration operator with unchanged behavior checks and an independent vulnerability rescan.
candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Run package-manager bump plus free advisory rescan/build/tests first; stop if it already meets complete outcome. Inspect ordinary codemods and existing agent results before claiming invention.
candidates.paying_party_and_capture: Application operator or software supplier; independent security procurement need exists, but no price or repeatable AGI ALPHA capture is measured.
candidates.available_tools: uv and npm installed; pip_audit and Docker absent. Free install availability untested. No Snyk token or paid agent use authorized.
candidates.decision: BOUNDED_PROBE_ONLY if an accessible residual case is acquired; strongest-comparator advantage UNKNOWN

recommendation: Do not force a flagship from these three. Safe dependency remediation is the closest executable probe, but its current strong comparators and access costs block an enabling-advantage conclusion. Preserve physical/accessibility alternatives as unadmitted, not failed scientific mechanisms.
